prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1417; do not mention it.)
text:
We represent the injured party in connection with the collision that occurred while our client was turning left at an intersection. Our client sustained injuries in the crash and has retained this firm to handle all matters arising from it. Please direct all future communications regarding this claim to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We ask that you disclose the bodily injury liability limits of the policy issued to the other driver, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please provide this information in writing within fourteen days of receipt of this letter.

We also request that your company preserve all evidence related to this loss. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle data, repair estimates, telematics or dashcam footage, and any communications with the other driver. Please ensure that no material is altered, discarded, or repaired without prior notice to this office so that all parties have an opportunity to inspect it.
